summary: Frontend-only testing of Apollo Threat Lab bottom-sheet modal lifecycle. All core features verified via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667).

integration_issues.flow: Safe Traffic Test on web preview
integration_issues.issue: CORS blocks fetch to example.com in web preview environment - expected behavior, not a bug. Modal correctly shows 'Failed' status with informative outcome text.

critical_code_review_comments: The 'Test in progress...' spinner state is very brief for fast-failing tests (CORS errors) in web preview - modal goes straight to completed state. This is expected behavior, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All modal lifecycle flows verified: home screen loads 10 cards in dark navy theme, clicking scenario triggers bottom-sheet modal, running spinner shown (briefly for fast-fail cases), completed state shows 'OBSERVED OUTCOME' section with result text, Close button (testID=result-close-button) dismisses modal. Settings (/settings) and History (/history) navigation both work correctly.
